title: Aplikasi Toko Online - Threat Model
description: Threat model lengkap untuk aplikasi manajemen toko online (threaddragon.com) dengan React Frontend, Node.js API Server, MySQL Database, Redis Cache, dan Payment Gateway Integration (Midtrans/Xendit)

elements.name: Customer
elements.description: User yang melakukan registrasi, login, belanja, dan pembayaran

elements.name: Admin
elements.description: Admin user yang mengelola produk, order, dan transaksi

elements.name: Payment Gateway (Midtrans/Xendit)
elements.description: External payment provider untuk proses pembayaran dan verifikasi transaksi

elements.name: React Frontend
elements.description: User Interface Layer - Aplikasi web React untuk customer dan admin

elements.name: Node.js REST API Server
elements.description: Backend API - Business logic, authentication, order processing, payment handling

elements.name: Email Service
elements.description: Email notification service untuk order confirmation, password reset, alerts

elements.name: Authentication Module
elements.description: JWT token generation, validation, refresh token management

elements.name: MySQL Database
elements.description: Primary data storage untuk user, products, orders, transactions (AES-256 encrypted)

elements.name: Redis Cache
elements.description: In-memory cache untuk session, user data, product cache (TTL: 1800 seconds)

flows.label: User Input & Browse
flows.description: Customer melakukan input (login, register, search, order)

flows.label: Admin Management
flows.description: Admin mengelola produk, order, dan transaksi melalui frontend

flows.label: REST API Calls
flows.description: Frontend melakukan HTTP request ke backend API

flows.label: Database Queries
flows.description: API melakukan query ke MySQL database

flows.label: Cache Operations
flows.description: API cache session dan data ke Redis

flows.label: Payment Request & Verification
flows.description: API mengirim payment request dan menerima webhook callback

flows.label: Email Notification
flows.description: API mengirim email untuk order confirmation, alerts, password reset

flows.label: Authentication
flows.description: API menggunakan auth module untuk token generation dan validation

threats.title: THREAT-001: Spoofing Identitas User - Session Hijacking
threats.description: Attacker dapat mencuri JWT token melalui XSS atau network sniffing untuk mengakses akun user

threats.title: THREAT-002: Tampering Data Harga Produk
threats.description: Attacker dapat mengubah harga produk di frontend sebelum melakukan pembayaran

mitigations.title: Database Audit Logging untuk Price Changes

threats.title: THREAT-003: Information Disclosure - Kebocoran Data Customer
threats.description: Attacker dapat mengakses data customer yang sensitive melalui API endpoint yang tidak ter-protect

threats.title: THREAT-004: Denial of Service (DoS) - Server Overload
threats.description: Attacker dapat overload server dengan request volume tinggi, menyebabkan service unavailable

threats.title: THREAT-005: Elevation of Privilege - Unauthorized Admin Access
threats.description: Regular user dapat mengakses admin functions atau escalate privilege mereka

mitigations.title: JWT Role-Based Authorization dengan Role Verification
Comprehensive Audit Logging untuk Admin Actions
Principle of Least Privilege untuk Admin Roles

threats.title: THREAT-006: Tampering Transaksi Pembayaran
threats.description: Attacker dapat memanipulasi status transaksi pembayaran tanpa benar-benar melakukan pembayaran

threats.title: THREAT-007: SQL Injection Attack
threats.description: Attacker dapat inject SQL commands melalui unsanitized input untuk mengakses atau memodifikasi database

mitigations.title: WAF Rules untuk SQL Injection Detection

threats.title: THREAT-008: Repudiation - User Deny Transaksi
threats.description: User dapat menyangkal bahwa mereka melakukan transaksi tertentu karena tidak ada proof

mitigations.title: Comprehensive Audit Logging (who, what, when, where)
Email Confirmation untuk Setiap Transaksi Penting

threats.title: THREAT-009: Command Injection - Email Header Injection
threats.description: Attacker dapat inject commands di email headers untuk spam atau send ke unauthorized recipients

elements.name: SEC-REQ-001: Authentication & Session Management
elements.description: JWT token expiration 30 min, refresh token rotation, HttpOnly cookies, CSRF protection, MFA for admin, rate limiting on login

elements.name: SEC-REQ-002: Data Protection & Encryption
elements.description: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, encrypted backups, key rotation every 90 days, PII masking in responses

elements.name: SEC-REQ-003: Role-Based Access Control
elements.description: RBAC implementation, user-owned resource isolation, admin MFA, IP whitelisting, audit logging, default-deny principle

elements.name: SEC-REQ-004: Input Validation & Injection Prevention
elements.description: Server-side validation, parameterized queries, output encoding, rate limiting, CAPTCHA, CSP headers

elements.name: SEC-REQ-005: Payment Security & Transaction Integrity
elements.description: Server-side price validation, webhook signature verification, transaction signing, idempotency key, PCI DSS compliance

commonReferences.name: STRIDE Threat Modeling Framework
commonReferences.description: Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, Denial of Service, Elevation of Privilege

commonReferences.name: PCI DSS v3.2 Compliance
commonReferences.description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
